key_insight: PPO-HRAP improves trading risk-adjusted performance by blending PPO actions with a volatility-aware, regime-derived exposure prior.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a practical control strategy for automated portfolio management when both return capture and drawdown suppression are critical.
method: Combines Proximal Policy Optimization with an interpretable regime-aware target exposure.
Uses market features plus portfolio-state variables as inputs.
Reward mixes log return, VIX-conditioned drawdown penalty, target-exposure deviation, and turnover cost.
evidence_signal: On the held-out 2020-2022 SPY test window, the method achieved 27.62% total return with 18.47% max drawdown, and across five SPY seeds it remained stable with mean Sharpe 0.6219 ± 0.0565.
watch_item: The policy still has high turnover, and cross-asset robustness beyond SPY is supported only by single-run results.
paper_title: PPO-HRAP: Proximal Policy Optimization with a Hybrid Regime-Aware Policy for Risk-Controlled Trading
